about: Provider subscription-userinfo headers and what they parse to. Read by system-go/subscription_userinfo_test.go and ui/src/rowStatus.test.ts, so the runtime's parser and the UI's fallback for an older runtime give the same answer. A key missing from want means the field is left out.

cases.name: no spaces, keys out of order
spaces around every separator and mixed case keys
commas instead of semicolons, a trailing separator
floats and exponent form are truncated
garbage values drop only their own field
a negative value is refused, not read as zero
the first valid value for a key wins
a refused value does not block a later valid one
expire of zero means never and is left out
expire in milliseconds is scaled to seconds
expire in milliseconds with a remainder truncates
unknown keys and pairs without a value are ignored
a value past int64 is refused, not wrapped
number spellings other than decimal are refused
not a userinfo header at all
